name: NosDB
tagline: Alachisoft's 2015-era distributed JSON document database for .NET; quietly dropped in favor of NCache.
description: NosDB was a schema-less, distributed JSON document database for .NET applications from Alachisoft, the company behind the NCache distributed cache. It offered sharded, replicated clusters with multi-datacenter support, a SQL-like query language and LINQ over JSON documents, an ADO.NET provider, MapReduce and aggregation, Power BI integration, and .NET, Java and REST clients, in an Apache 2.0 open-source edition alongside a commercial Enterprise edition. Alachisoft abandoned it around 2016–2017: the GitHub repository has been removed and the old product URL now redirects to NCache. There is no supported path; MongoDB, RavenDB or Azure Cosmos DB fill the same niche for .NET teams.
statusNote: Abandoned by Alachisoft around 2016–2017; repository removed and product URL redirects to NCache. Use MongoDB, RavenDB or Cosmos DB.

license.name: Apache License 2.0 (open-source edition); commercial Enterprise edition

strengths: Native .NET stack with LINQ and an ADO.NET provider
Sharding and replication designed by an established distributed-cache vendor
weaknesses: Abandoned by its vendor; code and downloads are gone
Windows/.NET-only ecosystem that never built a community
useCases: Planning a migration off an old NosDB deployment
